newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - News details aircraft leases.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - News details aircraft leases.

text.p: Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd said it held US$1.02 billion worth of contracts to purchase aircraft over the next six years through its aircraft purchasing joint venture Ansett Worldwide Aviation Equipment (AWAE).

As of June 30, 1996, AWAE held contracts to purchase aircraft for delivery between 1996 and 2002 at contract prices of $1.02 billion, compared with $1.336 billion a year earlier, News Corp said in its annual report released on Thursday.
It said it had paid deposits of $92 million at June 30, 1996 towards the purchase of the aircraft.
AWAE is jointly owned with transport group TNT Ltd.

News Corp also has a 50 percent interest in Ansett Worldwide Aviation Services (AWAS), which leases the aircraft that AWAE purchases. The media giant's other aviation interest is a 50 percent stake in Ansett Aviation Ltd.
Air New Zealand Ltd holds the other half of Ansett after purchasing the stake from TNT.
